description: BİZ 3 ÖĞRENCİ SANAT VE ASTRONOMİYİ SEVİYORUZ.
summary:
Our main goal is to keep the legacy of NASA’s Opportunity rover alive and introduce its remarkable story to future generations.

Opportunity was designed to operate for only 90 Martian days, but it explored Mars for 15 years and traveled more than 45 kilometers. Although its mission ended in 2018, its scientific contributions and discoveries should never be forgotten.

We believe children should know the stories behind these historic space missions, not just see them as facts on a screen.

To achieve this, we created an interactive Mars environment using styrofoam and built a moving Opportunity rover with LEGO. We programmed it to travel across the Martian surface and transformed its real mission story into an engaging children’s fairy tale, complete with audio narration. QR codes connect children to authentic NASA resources.

Our dream is to exhibit ASTROART at the Gaziantep Science Center and other science centers across Türkiye, allowing thousands of children to discover Opportunity’s journey.

Through robotics, coding, storytelling, and hands-on learning, we turn a completed space mission into a living educational experience.

The mission may have ended, but its story must continue.

We are Team ASTROART. The journey of discovery continues with us!
